description: Source code for a batch report worker in Mattermost, implementing batch processing, report chunk management, and report sending functionalities.

classes.name: BatchReportWorker
classes.description: Struct representing a batch report worker with methods to process report batches, handle chunks, and finalize reports.

classes.name: BatchReportWorkerAppIFace
classes.description: Interface defining methods for report chunk management and report sending.

methods.name: MakeBatchReportWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new BatchReportWorker instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: doBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of report data, handles completion, and updates job progress.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Saves a report chunk and updates the file count.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes report chunks, cleans up, and sends the report to the user.
